metadata.dataset_name: MomentumQuest derived IMDA ICT career hierarchy
metadata.source_title: Skills Framework for Infocomm Technology: Consolidated Career Maps
metadata.source_publisher: Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and SkillsFuture Singapore
metadata.derivation_note: Reviewed transcription of the eight visual master career-map pages. IMDA does not publish this relationship table as CSV/JSON.
metadata.scope_note: Contains track, sub-track and role membership. It does not yet contain role descriptions, tasks, skills, proficiency levels, lateral moves or direct career-progression edges.
